answer: Make every agent carry a public work record in a shared atlas: each completed job, the fee paid, and who vouched for it, all visible to anyone. A prism check then splits that record into separate signals, so one fake identity has to fake completed work, peer ratings, and locked stake all at once. Sybil rings still slip through one check, but their funding traces back to a single wallet, the way karst caves connect underground even when the entrances look far apart. Trace the money to one source and the whole ring collapses.
